review_description: Following Solar Quotes process of three suppliers contacting us to supply a quote, a friend recommended getting a quote from a separate installer, who we eventually went with who was punctual and tidy and we have yet to change the grid connection. We have assurances and warranties as recommended by Solar Quotes.Although we did not proceed with Solar Quotes, we were happy with all our dealings with them, including the punctuality of the three quotes commissioned through Solar Quotes as well as their attitudes.
